item.title: How a 16-year-old race in SQLite's WAL survived until Tailscale checkpointed too hard
item.description: Tailscale spent six months chasing 19 unexplained database corruption incidents and traced them to a 16-year-old race condition in SQLite's WAL checkpointing — a bug the SQLite team fixed in 3.51.3.
